member.name: T:PropertyOS.Api.Controllers.HealthController
member.summary: Provides endpoints for monitoring the operational health of the PropertyOS API.
member.remarks: Health endpoints are used by monitoring systems, deployment pipelines, load balancers, and other infrastructure components to verify that the API is running and capable of processing incoming requests.

member.name: M:PropertyOS.Api.Controllers.HealthController.Get
member.summary: Returns the current operational health status of the PropertyOS API.
member.remarks: A successful response indicates that the API is running and able to process requests. Additional dependency checks, such as database connectivity and external service availability, may be added in future iterations.
member.returns: A 200 OK response containing the API's current health status, service identifier, and the current UTC timestamp.
member.response: The API is operational and successfully processed the health check request.

member.name: T:PropertyOS.Api.Controllers.OrganizationsController
member.summary: Provides endpoints for retrieving information about the current organization.
member.remarks: Organization endpoints are tenant-aware. In Sprint 1 these endpoints return stub data while the organization and multi-tenant infrastructure is being established. Future sprints will resolve the current organization from the authenticated user's context.

member.name: M:PropertyOS.Api.Controllers.OrganizationsController.GetCurrent
member.remarks: This endpoint currently returns placeholder data and will be implemented once organization persistence and tenant resolution are introduced.
member.returns: A 200 OK response containing placeholder organization information.
member.response: The current organization was successfully retrieved.
